record.context_brief: positive sectional curvature on 6-manifolds with χ>0
record.original_question: Does every compact oriented 6-manifold M with positive Euler characteristic χ(M) > 0 admit a metric of positive sectional curvature?

evidence.quote: Question 3.19. Does a compact oriented 6-manifold M with χ(M)>0 admit a metric of positive sectional curvature ?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $M$ be a compact, oriented, smooth 6-dimensional manifold with positive Euler characteristic, $\chi(M) > 0$. Determine whether $M$ necessarily admits a Riemannian metric of positive sectional curvature (i.e., a smooth Riemannian metric $g$ such that for every point $p \in M$ and every 2-plane $\sigma \subset T_p M$, the sectional curvature $K_g(\sigma) > 0$).
artifact.status_search_result: The question is closely tied to the Hopf-type problems on existence and obstructions for positively curved metrics. In dimension 6, classification of compact oriented manifolds admitting positive sectional curvature is widely regarded as open; only a handful of examples are known (S^6, CP^3, the Wallach space SU(3)/T^2, and the Eschenburg biquotient SU(3)//T^2), and topological obstructions for general 6-manifolds with χ>0 have not been established. Recent work (e.g., on 6-manifolds with non-abelian symmetry, 2019) continues to investigate the problem, indicating it remains open.

status_evidence.title: Riemannian Manifolds with Positive Sectional Curvature (Ziller survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of known examples and open problems concerning positively curved manifolds, including the limited list in dimension 6.
status_evidence.claim: The classification/existence question for positively curved metrics on compact 6-manifolds is treated as open, with only a few known examples.

status_evidence.title: On Closed 6-Manifolds Admitting Riemannian Metrics with Positive Sectional Curvature and Non-Abelian Symmetry
status_evidence.snippet: Study of closed 6-manifolds with positive sectional curvature under symmetry assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent research continues to investigate which 6-manifolds support positive sectional curvature, indicating the general question remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Hopf conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of Hopf's conjectures relating Euler characteristic and positive sectional curvature.
status_evidence.claim: The relationship between χ>0 and existence of positive sectional curvature metrics is part of the family of Hopf conjectures, which remain open in dimension ≥6.
